quest.title: Unexpected Battle
quest.description: You and Paimon were having a stroll across the Byakko Plain, intending to enjoy some hard-come-by peace and quiet, but you come across an unexpected conflict nonetheless...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Tadatsune
dialogues.text: After all these years, senpai... I was hoping it would never come to settling this with real swords...

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: Cut out that weak-sounding nonsense. C'mon, it's between you and me! There can be only one victor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, why are those two fighting on the road?

dialogues.speaker: Tadatsune
dialogues.text: Hmm? Someone else is here? Hey, get away from here, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're disciples of the Kono Ittou Art, and are about to settle things with a duel. We don't want anyone getting in the way, especially outsiders like you who know nothing of the sword arts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, come on now... You're the ones fighting in the middle of the road.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what do you mean we "know nothing of the sword arts"? When it comes to wielding a sword, the Traveler here is super strong.

dialogues.speaker: Tadatsune
dialogues.text: Eh? So you're just another person looking to steal our chance to compete. In that case, we'd better team up and deal with this outsider first. What say you, senpai?

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: Sounds like a plan to me.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, good to see you. Unfortunately, both the Commissioner and Miss Kamisato are out on business for the day. They are not here at the estate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we're not here to see them today. Actually, we were hoping to ask about the Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition. You know, the event being hosted by the Yashiro Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Ahh, so the Traveler wants to enter the competition, too? I'm terribly sorry, but we were flooded with applicants, and all the entry tickets were already issued last week.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: But if you want tickets to see the final exhibition match, I'll see what I can do. Perhaps I can get you some...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no, let us explain! We were able to get our hands on an entry ticket today, but we haven't decided whether or not to participate. We wanted to get some info about it first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: From the sound of it, this competition is really popular.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Indeed, Warrior's Spirit is a competition with a rich history in Inazuma. Not only is it a good opportunity for martial artists to test their strength, but it is also a form of honor.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: The Almighty Shogun hopes to use this opportunity to spread the elegance of the art of the sword to more people. The upcoming competition has introduced many new formats to appeal to a wide variety of spectators.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Traveler, since you already have an entry ticket, you should enter the competition. It is a rare opportunity, after all.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: By the way, given you've only heard about the competition today, you probably don't know yet, but Miss Kamisato just...

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: Why hesitate when faced with such a great opportunity?

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: If you're not honored to be a part of Warrior's Spirit, there's no need for you to hold on to that entry ticket. There are plenty of others who are eager to enter.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: What are you saying, Hirotatsu? That's not how we speak to our guests.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: I don't mean any insult, Madarame. On the contrary, I would love to see the Traveler in action.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: Everyone here has heard of you, even Miss Kamisato thinks highly of you. I always assumed you'd be someone we'd all look up to.

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: But now it seems everything we heard were nothing more than rumors. You lack spirit, and as for your swordsmanship... Well, I'm sure it's mediocre at best. Otherwise, you wouldn't hesitate even for a second about joining the competition.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: Hey c'mon, Hirotatsu, the Traveler isn't from a martial family. Besides, spirit and swordsmanship can also be displayed other ways besides competitions...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Agh, can you believe this guy!? That makes two groups of people talking down to us on the same day!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ugh, there's nothing Paimon hates more than people underestimating {NICKNAME} when they don't even know {M#him}{F#her}... Well, maybe feeling hungry is worse, but still!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But this Hirotatsu guy doesn't even know you! How can he say that you lack spirit and ability!? Oh, that's it, Paimon's mad now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He deserves an ugly nickname, like... Umm, like... oh! "Not the Sharpest Samurai"!

response.speaker: Hirotatsu
response.text: You can run your mouth all you like, but this isn't something that can be proven with words. I, Hirotatsu, am a true warrior, and don't need to go around bragging to make a name for myself. I'll take my leave now.

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: Ah, I apologize about Hirotatsu. He's the type of person that tends to just say whatever comes to his mind.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No worries, he'll see what I'm made of.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Does that mean you're entering the competition? Great, Paimon approves! Show "Not the Sharpest Samurai" that you're the real deal!

response.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
response.text: The competition starts on Ritou in two days. I didn't get a chance to tell you just now, but Miss Kamisato left for Ritou today to discuss competition matters with Miss Hiiragi Chisato.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh really? In that case, let's go meet Ayaka on Ritou. We can ask her for more details about the competition.

choices.text: But we have other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... you finally got them to stop. Hey you two, this is all just a big misunderstanding! We're just passing through here. We didn't want to steal anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, what's all this about a chance to compete?

dialogues.speaker: Tadatsune
dialogues.text: Ugh... senpai, how could this happen? This youngster completely overwhelmed us with only a few moves!

dialogues.speaker: Tadatsune
dialogues.text: I thought this would be our chance to show the power of the Kono Ittou Art to the world. Who knew we would be defeated before we even set foot in the arena...

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: No need to say any more... What happened here only proves that we're out of our depth.

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: *sigh* Master did always tell us that no matter how strong you may become, there is always someone stronger. But we didn't listen...

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: As for this entry ticket, I'm afraid that no matter which of us use it, the results would be the same.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what are you two mumbling about? You guys were at each other's throats just a moment ago.

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: I'm sorry for the misunderstanding. We're disciples of the Kono Ittou Art. Just now, we were about to duel to see who would enter the Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition.

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: This competition is very important to any practitioner of the sword arts, and since we rarely see anyone pass through here, we mistook you for a competitor trying to steal our entry ticket. Again, I apologize.

choices.text: Now that that's been cleared up...

response.speaker: Tadaaki
response.text: Ah, just a moment, please! If it wasn't for you, I would have never realized my own inadequacy.

response.speaker: Tadatsune
response.text: Right, our fight just now was a real eye-opener. I know now that I must further cultivate both my mind and swordsmanship.

response.speaker: Tadaaki
response.text: #Senpai, I have an idea. Why don't we give the entry ticket to {M#him}{F#her}?

response.speaker: Tadaaki
response.text: Fine by me. Only a real swordsman is qualified to stand in the Warrior's Spirit arena. We still require more training.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait wait wait, you mean you want {NICKNAME} to compete instead of you?

response.speaker: Tadatsune
response.text: It's up to you if you want to join. Either way, this entry ticket is useless to us now. We bid you two farewell.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there they go, just like that... Ugh, so what do we do about this entry ticket they left us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let Paimon see here... "Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Competition... hosted by the Yashiro Commission." Hmm, since it's being held by the Yashiro Commission, why don't we go to the Kamisato Estate and ask about it?

choices.text: But we don't know anything about the competition...

talks.objective: Go to the Kamisato Estate and ask Madarame for information
Go to Ritou and look for Kamisato Ayaka

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayaka, Chisato~!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, nice to see you again. Welcome back to Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice to see you too, Ayaka! Actually, we've decided to enter the Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition. We heard you two were making preparations on Ritou, so we thought we'd come and check things out.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. We just finished talking about the Archon's Emissary and whether the Traveler would be interested in the exhibition. And now here you are!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Archon's Emissary? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, you've never heard of it? Didn't you come rushing back to Inazuma because of Miss Ayaka's letter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Letter? What letter?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind that now. Paimon, you were asking about the Archon's Emissary?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The Archon's Emissary has a special responsibility in the Warrior's Spirit event. However, it's hard to describe without touching on the origins of this event.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Warrior's Spirit originated from ancient Inazuman legends. It is said that a long time ago, the martial artist who was crowned champion would be granted the special honor of meeting and engaging in a sword duel with the Almighty Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: However, the Almighty Shogun was far more powerful than any human being. In a direct confrontation, the duel would be over in an instant.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Therefore, the Almighty Shogun would send one of her familiars as an emissary to the martial artist, who would then provide assistance and protection in the fight against the Shogun.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Because the Almighty Shogun decided to convey her skills and the will to protect the citizens of Inazuma through the form of martial arts, the duel was then aptly named Warrior's Spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Later, the event evolved into a competition that focused on the art of swordsmanship, and the tradition of a duel with the divine has been retained as the final "exhibition match" of the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This final match allows later generations to understand the origin of Warrior's Spirit and the meaning of martial arts.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, sounds like a pretty important event.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes. Nowadays, the Almighty Shogun won't attend the exhibition match in person, but she will still send a special envoy to fight on her behalf to display her divine strength.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Of course, the role of the "Martial Artist" goes to the winner of the competition, and the "Divine Familiar" will be fulfilled by a true swordsman, a role also known as the "Archon's Emissary."

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This time, I will be fulfilling the role of the Archon's Emissary.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, so that's what this is all about! Paimon gets why this competition is so popular now! After all, Ayaka is popular among the citizens of Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Paimon's right. Though the Shirasagi Himegimi attends some festival ceremonies from time to time, it's not often that we get to see her excellent swordsmanship up close.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: The Almighty Shogun said that this time, we need to host a competition aimed at the public and recruit a powerful ambassador to promote it. With that in mind, Ayaka was appointed as the Archon's Emissary.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, and by the way, this is Onodera from Yae Publishing House. He specializes in organizing events and was sent to assist us. He was the one who suggested that Ayaka be the Archon's Emissary.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: In addition, he proposed two strategies to increase the popularity of the competition... expanding the target audience and increasing word of mouth. His ideas have been most effective.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, those ideas sound pretty professional! But, uh, what do they actually mean?

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Well, "expanding the target audience" means getting more people involved in the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Previously, competitors were required to be practitioners of one of Inazuma's schools of swordsmanship. However, this time, the requirements are different. Anyone who has a passion for martial arts can participate, regardless of nationality or status.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: Some combat regulations have similarly been adjusted, weapons are no longer limited to one-handed swords. Any close-range weapon that meets the length and weight requirements can be used.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: As for "increasing word of mouth," in my personal experience, the most effective method is to hold a vote.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A vote?

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: That's right. In the past, it was the Almighty Shogun who decided what the Archon's Emissary would wear in the exhibition match. But this time, with support from the Almighty Shogun, we'll be giving that choice to the audience.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: People can vote on one of the four seasonal styles, such as cherry blossoms or autumn leaves. Miss Kamisato will wear whichever outfit receives the most votes.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Although voting won't begin until the day of the competition, my retainers have already been speculating on which theme will win.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: These plans are only possible because Miss Kamisato agreed to be the Archon's Emissary. I know this must be a lot of pressure for you, Miss Kamisato.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: No, not at all. It's an honor for me to have an opportunity to promote the sword arts. If anything, it's your dedication to the event that everyone will appreciate.

dialogues.speaker: Onodera
dialogues.text: You flatter me, Miss Kamisato. Now then, I must get back to preparing some final details regarding the vote, so please excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon, now that you're here, Miss Chisato and I can show you around the competition venue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That'd be great! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's getting late and Miss Chisato and I must return now. The two of you should have a good rest for the next couple days. We'll see you on the day of the competition.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks, you two! Will do! See you on the day of the competition!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, now this is an arena... Paimon had no idea the Outlander Affairs Agency would have a place like this.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This is the indoor training area for the Kanjou Commission. It's thanks to Miss Chisato that we were able to use this venue.

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: You're very welcome, Miss Ayaka. I'm only happy I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chisato, what's that over there?

dialogues.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
dialogues.text: Oh, that? Well, it's...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Ahem. Traveler, do you have a moment... to talk?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hmm, where should I begin...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe start by explaining the letter... What was that about?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Ah yes, that... Nothing slips by you. To be honest, I felt a little apprehensive when I first heard that everyone wanted me to be the Archon's Emissary.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I've been making public appearances ever since I was a child, but this is the first time I've ever acted as the ambassador for such an event, not to mention wearing an extravagant outfit while participating in combat.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: In the past, only the most skilled swordsmen of a reputable clan in Inazuma were qualified to be the Archon's Emissary. I'm afraid my skills can't even begin to compare to theirs.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I was worried that I might not be up to the task, so I wanted to write to you and ask for your advice at that time.

choices.text: We're friends, you can have my advice anytime.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Yes, I know. But that's probably why I didn't send the letter in the end.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: You've helped me many times before, and you've always lent me your ear when I speak about my troubles. But if I'm always turning to you for help, it almost feels like you're somehow besting me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Hehe, is it strange for a friend to think that way?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Thank you. I was really delighted to learn that you also entered the competition...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey Ayaka... Huh? What were you two chatting about?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: #I was just saying that it's delightful to have the Traveler join the competition. Given {M#his}{F#her} reputation in Inazuma, the competition is sure to be even more exciting.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heehee, yep! Having the Traveler join will definitely heat things up a little!

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Paimon's right, I look forward to seeing you perform.

choices.text: I'd be happy to help however I can.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Miss Kamisato should have arrived on Ritou by now. She went to discuss competition matters with Miss Hiiragi Chisato of the Kanjou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Madarame Hyakubei
dialogues.text: Miss Kamisato also has an important responsibility in the competition. Since you're going to see her, she can fill you in on the details.

talks.objective: Talk to Kamisato Ayaka outside the arena

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh look, there's Ayaka and Chisato.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Ah Traveler, Paimon, you made it. Did you rest well yesterday?

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: That's the Traveler, composed as always.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mhm, it's important to keep a good mood before a competition. We're in it to win it!

response.speaker: Onodera
response.text: Looks like you all are in good spirits today. Everything should be set to go for the opening match...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, are these two boxes for voting?

response.speaker: Onodera
response.text: That's right, I've arranged everything. The box on the left contains the ballots for Warrior's Spirit, while the box on the right is for the other events. The results will be revealed in the third round of the competition.

response.speaker: Onodera
response.text: And given how strong the Traveler is, you're practically guaranteed to make the third round, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You bet!

response.speaker: Mizuta
response.text: Mr. Onodera, we'll start with the box for Warrior's Spirit then!

response.speaker: Onodera
response.text: Alright, thank you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Things are about to start soon. Let's head to the arena.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Good luck, Traveler. I hope you'll do well in the competition.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: Well, Miss Ayaka and I should go watch the matches. See you later.

choices.text: Actually, I didn't get much sleep.

response.speaker: Hiiragi Chisato
response.text: And yet, you're still just as composed as always.

dialogues.speaker: Hirotatsu
dialogues.text: Are you really going to enter the competition? Heh, in that case, see you in the arena.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, do you hear that? Sounds like someone's arguing over there. Let's go see what's happening!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh, what's up with these guys? Now they're suddenly charging at us!? Ahh, watch out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Tadaaki
dialogues.text: This single chance belongs to the Kono Ittou Art.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Today's the opening ceremony for the Warrior's Spirit Swordfighting Exhibition. C'mon, let's head to the arena.
